findings_and_connected_existing.first_contract: A non-flat finite support triangle should not measure as grade zero merely because the horizontal normal length calculation loses its squared components. validate_encoded checks only that the normal is finite and normal.y is nonzero before calling maximum_grade.
findings_and_connected_existing.static_reasoning: For abstract triangle edges (s,s,0) and (0,s,s) with s=2^-40, the locked glam cross source yields normal (2^-80,-2^-80,2^-80): each component is finite and Y is nonzero. Under ordinary IEEE f32 arithmetic, each horizontal square is 2^-160, below half the least subnormal, so the shown Vec2 dot and length produce zero; division by 2^-80 gives grade zero although the exact planar grade is sqrt(2). Thus the shown normal gate does not reject this mechanism, and a positive configured limit would not reject that computed zero at the grade comparison. No triangle, fixture, calculation, decoder or product was executed.
findings_and_connected_existing.conditions: This follows the locked package text and ordinary rounding assumptions; actual compiled feature/target/FP mode, all region/membership/floor checks, caller policy, supported generated or decoded surface and physical use remain unproved. It is not a claim that a complete surface passes or that a player sees a failure. PlanPolygon and GroundTriangle bounded source show no blanket minimum area in the displayed gates, but do not establish the rest of the route.
